info.name: AgencyOps API
info.description: AgencyOps — Software Agency & Development Team Management SaaS. Base URL variable: {{baseUrl}} (default http://localhost:5000/api/v1). After Register or Login, accessToken/refreshToken are auto-captured into collection variables by the Tests script on those two requests — you don't need to copy them manually. The refresh token itself travels only via an HttpOnly cookie, set automatically by Postman's cookie jar.
